about: One trial's result is not a general claim about everyone.

findings.title: Trial report
findings.content: A 2025 trial of 165 adults found that 4:3 intermittent fasting produced 7.6% weight loss versus 5.0% with daily calorie restriction at 12 months.

claims.claim: Intermittent fasting produces more weight loss than calorie restriction for everyone.
In a 2025 trial of 165 adults, 4:3 intermittent fasting produced 7.6% weight loss versus 5.0% with daily calorie restriction at 12 months.
